else.reason: Company Name is historical unless Current Name Indicator equals Y

then.reason: Current Name is not used when Current Name Indicator is present
Type RACN denotes an ARBN under another law, so the ACN field value is not an ACN

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Company name as it appears on the register
field_mappings.transformation: Emit the trimmed raw Company Name as the current legal name only where Current Name Indicator equals Y, which the Current Name Indicator definition gives as the flag for the current company name. Do not emit Company Name for rows where Current Name Indicator is null, because those rows show a historical name. Do not emit null or blank values.

Where Current Name Indicator is null, emit the trimmed Current Name as the current legal name for the company. Current Name is the documented current company name for those historical-record rows. Do not emit null or blank values and do not use Current Name for rows where the indicator equals Y.
Parse the ABN as a whole-cell 11-digit Australian Business Number and validate its checksum. Reject the documented ELSE show 0 placeholder and any value that fails the checksum.
When Type equals RACN the ACN field holds an ARBN, so omit the value. Otherwise use the 9-digit ACN with leading zeros preserved and validate its checksum.

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Date on which a company was registered
field_mappings.transformation: Parse the documented DD/MM/YYYY value as a date using format %d/%m/%Y. Do not assign a timezone.

Map documented codes APTY (Australian proprietary company), APUB (Australian public company) and FNOS (foreign company incorporated outside Australia) to company. RACN is omitted. Unlisted codes resolve to no value.
Map only the documented code DRGD (De-registered) to deregistered. Other codes including EXAD have no supported equivalent here and resolve to no value.

unmapped_fields.reason: Date of Deregistration is a lifecycle date for the registration, not whole-observation validity, so no valid_to or other time slot is established.
Class is a liability-type code, not an ANZSIC industry code, so it has no supported industry_code output.
Sub Class is a company sub-class code, not an ANZSIC industry code, so it has no supported industry_code output.
Previous State of Registration is the state of original registration, not a current business address for the subject, so it is not mapped to address.state.
State Registration number is a state-issued registration identifier with no canonical field in this ontology slice.
Modified since last report is a change-tracking flag, not a canonical business claim.
Current Name Indicator is used only as a predicate for the legal name mappings and has no independent canonical output.
Current Name Start Date is the start date of a name and has no canonical date field here.
_id is an internal dataset row identifier, not a business claim.
